title: Megan The Stallion Reacts To Her Los Angeles Home Being Ransacked
htmlContent:
Megan Thee Stallion's house in L.A. was trashed by a pair of thieves who made their way into her bedroom -- taking hundreds of thousands of assets.

According to law enforcement sources, two men wearing hoodies and gloves smashed a glass door in the back of Megan The Stallion's home on Thursday evening, giving them access to the inside. We're told from there that the men went into the primary bedroom.

Per TMZ, the crooks took about $300,000 to $400,000 worth of jewelry, cash, and electronics from inside the house. Also Stallion was not home with the break-in occurred.

The police have not made any arrest, but there is home surveillance of the break-in, and detectives are working on getting more videos and evidence from neighbors that might help them catch the perpetrators.

Megan spoke about the burglary and announced that she was, “really gotta take a break.”

“Material things can be replaced but I’m glad everyone is safe ,” she wrote, later adding, “Hotties I’m really sorry but after SNL I really gotta take a break I’m so tired, physically and emotionally.”
